summary.text: Anthony Pennock is the Democratic candidate for the Michigan State Senate, District 18, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A special education teacher with an EdD in organizational leadership, he grew up in Pennfield.

paragraphs.text: Pennock graduated from Pennfield High School, earned associate degrees from Kellogg Community College in 2011, a bachelor's degree in education from Robert B. Miller College in 2015, a graduate degree in curriculum and instruction from Concordia University in 2016, and an EdD in organizational leadership from Grand Canyon University in 2021.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he grew up the youngest of five children in Pennfield and worked jobs including cashier, bartender and hotel night auditor before becoming a teacher.
He said that in 2019 he began advocating for fellow educators and building ties between teachers and support staff.
Pennock advanced from the Democratic primary on August 4, 2026.

He named fair wages tied to inflation, paid family leave and pension protection, school funding that does not depend on local property values, and protecting natural resources as key campaign messages.
